Title: Public Preview: StandardV2 NAT Gateway as an outbound type for AKS

Body.Content:
AKS now supports managed and user-assigned StandardV2 NAT Gateway as an outbound type for your AKS managed or BYO VNets. This unlocks zone-redundant outbound connectivity, up to 100 Gbps outbound throughput, and IPv6 outbound support for AKS clusters.

Learn more.
